# Draft:Historical geopolitical generational dementia

Historical geopolitical generational dementia (HGGD)
I am proposing this new terminology to explain the current status of international affairs on the basis of historical population behaviour (in March 2026).
Background
There has to be an explanation for the repeated behavioural pattern of large groups of humans (the population of each country on planet Earth) forgetting historical events and their impact on their daily lives, the lives of their fellow neighbours and the lives of future generations, including their own children's.
Today, we have access to a large compendium of evidence dating back to the birth of modern democracy. If we were to analyse this body of evidence going back 12 - 17 generations (240 - 330 years, considering a generation span is around 20 years), it will take us to the times of the birth of constitutional monarchy in modern UK (1689)(1), the start of the Industrial Revolution (1760)(2), the French Revolution (1789)(3), and the establishment of the USA constitution (1789)(4). And with these events, the world shaped the face of modern politics, political parties and the race for power.
Over 330 years, modern democracy and the race for power has had one common denominator: make promises to your voters; break them later. An endless cycle of making empty promises during your electoral campaign, get to power, implement policies that benefits your political and business network, get into lucrative government contracts funded by tax payers money (mainly the working class), and then try to do it all over again, knowing that this generation will forget in 20 years time, and the new one wouldn't have a clue about the recent past because they did not live it, it has been rewritten by the dominant, and powerful victors.
According to Dementia UK (5), dementia is marked by a decline in brain function, affecting memory, language, and behavior. Symptoms, worsen over time, including memory loss, confusion, and reduced independence. The description of this disease in humans has a strong correlation with the symptoms suffered by generation after generation when it comes to historical geopolitics events over the last 330 years, and led by the same perpetrators over and over again.
In conclusion, every generation over the last 330 years we have forgotten the lessons: a system has been put in place by the powerful establishment to protect their interest, and every political party, from the far-right to the far-left have been the vehicle to deliver it. The only treatment for Historical Geopolitical Generational Demential is to a profound political change where democracy is not a synonym of hypocrisy.
